docs.title: DVL Notes
docs.text:
Welcome to my storage administration notes, published straight from Obsidian.

This vault lives in the docs/ folder of the dvl_notes repo and is auto-built with MkDocs Material on every push.

docs.title: Sections
docs.text:
• Add new folders under docs/ for each topic (e.g. docs/san/, docs/nas/, docs/backup/).
  • Navigation is generated automatically — no manual nav editing required.
  • Standard [[Wikilinks]] from Obsidian work out of the box.
